wb.name: World Bank World Development Indicators
wb.upstream: Life expectancy: UN Population Division and national statistics offices. Literacy: UNESCO Institute for Statistics. Internet use: ITU.
wb.note: The figure the Society tab shows; stored here as the baseline.

undp.name: UNDP Human Development Report: composite indices time series
undp.upstream: Life expectancy: UN Population Division (WPP), the same upstream the World Bank draws on. Schooling: UNESCO UIS and national surveys.
undp.basis: Human Development Index and its components
undp.note: For life expectancy this mostly repeats WPP, so agreement shows the republication is consistent, not that two measurements agree.

wpp.name: UN World Population Prospects 2024: life expectancy at birth
wpp.publisher: UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
wpp.upstream: Census, vital registration and survey data compiled and modelled by the Population Division; the upstream of the World Bank's and UNDP's life-expectancy series.
wpp.note: Not an independent measurement of the World Bank figure: it is where that figure comes from for most countries.

uis.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics: adult literacy rate (SDG 4.6.2)
uis.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO (UNESCO open data licence)
uis.upstream: National censuses and household surveys; UIS estimates where there is none. This is the series the World Bank republishes as SE.ADT.LITR.ZS.
uis.basis: Share of people aged 15 and over who can read and write
uis.note: Agreement with the World Bank is by construction: it is the same series at the source, so a difference can only come from release timing.

factbook.name: CIA World Factbook
factbook.publisher: US Central Intelligence Agency, via the factbook.json mirror
factbook.licence: Public domain (work of the US government); the JSON mirror is by the factbook.json project
factbook.upstream: Compiled by the CIA from national statistics offices, the UN and ITU; the estimate year is given per figure.
factbook.basis: Editorial compilation; each figure carries its own estimate year
factbook.note: The most independent compiler in this set, but a compilation of the same national and UN data; years differ by country.

unavailable.name: WHO Global Health Observatory: life expectancy at birth
unavailable.reason: The GHO OData API (ghoapi.azureedge.net) answered every request with HTTP 500 during the build, so no figures were read. WHO data are also licensed CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO, which restricts commercial use.

unavailable.name: ITU DataHub: individuals using the Internet
unavailable.reason: The DataHub refused an automated request (HTTP 403) and offers no open bulk file. ITU is the upstream of the World Bank internet series, so it would not be independent of it in any case.
